mcqs.question: Under the proposal for an Indian Scientific Service, scientists are currently governed by which rules?
mcqs.explanation: Scientists are currently governed by the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. The proposal seeks a distinct scientific service framework, but the existing governing rules are the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964.

mcqs.question: In which year was the Electoral Trust Scheme launched?
mcqs.explanation: The Electoral Trust Scheme was launched in 2013. The tempting alternatives are incorrect because the scheme’s launch year was 2013, not 2014, 2015 or 2016.
